description: The advisory review of each npm lockfile (DS-08). The deps stage of scripts/test/run_checks.py recomputes the SHA-256 of the lockfile's registry packages, one name@version per line in sorted order, and fails when it differs from the reviewed set; every advisory found must have a disposition in docs/dependencies/strategy.lcl.txt (data.dep_advisory_dispositions).

reviews.source: OSV (api.osv.dev querybatch and vulns), queried with public package coordinates only
reviews.scope: All five advised packages are dev-only in the lockfile, reached only through the build and test tooling of @theia/cli, and never loaded by the running window. The shell leaves out @theia/plugin-ext-vscode and @theia/vsx-registry, so nothing unpacks extension archives at runtime (SA-08).
